title: Validate superseded archive reports consistently in PRs
rawUserRequest: 完成全部工单为止不要停。要确认的，我授权给你，并写入contract。

declaredIntent.summary: Align superseded archive Human Benefit Report validation between archive creation and aggregate PR checks without weakening evidence gates.

outOfScope: Do not relax Human Benefit Report validation for ordinary archived or active Work Items.
Do not modify preserved superseded predecessor Outcome or successor receipt bytes.
Do not merge or delete PR #792 until every required hosted check passes.

sources.reason: Archive creation preserves a valid superseded Outcome while generating the report from its virtual archive-path projection.
PR validation currently validates the report against the preserved unprojected Outcome and rejects the archive transaction.
Canonical authority for exact receipt-bound superseded transitions and the appropriate home for shared projection semantics.
Archive regression tests define byte preservation and report projection behavior.
Aggregate PR tests define fail-closed Human Benefit Report validation.

riskAssessment.reason: A broad report exception could accept stale or forged evidence; only an exact receipt-bound superseded transition may use the deterministic archive-path projection.

reasons: Initial Work Item skeleton defaults to Standard until scope is classified.

executionDecision.reason: The user authorized corrective completion and cleanup; the observed mismatch and fail-closed boundary are fully specified.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: PR validation accepts the archive-generated Human Benefit Report for an exact receipt-bound superseded transition by validating against the same deterministic archive-path Outcome projection used during archive creation.
Ordinary Outcomes, malformed or missing receipts, stale reports, unrelated report mutations, and incomplete report pairs continue to fail closed.
Archive creation and PR validation share one projection helper, with regression tests proving byte-preserved Outcome evidence and matching report behavior.
Focused tests and all declared quality and governance gates pass without changing the historical predecessor Outcome or receipt bytes.
guidelines: Keep supersession authority and archive-path projection semantics centralized in ai_lifecycle_truth.
Do not suppress Human Benefit Report validation errors; transform only the validated comparison input for an exact superseded transition.
Preserve ordinary fail-closed report ownership, freshness, pair completeness, and Markdown validation.

intent.problem: A valid superseded archive deliberately preserves the predecessor's red Outcome bytes while its Human Benefit Report is generated from a virtual archive-path rewrite. Aggregate PR validation compares that report to the preserved unrewritten Outcome, so the same archive transaction is rejected as stale after the Summary exception is applied.
constraints: The original superseded Outcome and successor receipt bytes must remain unchanged.
The virtual rewrite must be deterministic and identical in archive creation and PR validation.
Every non-superseded or malformed report remains subject to ordinary strict validation.
intent.rationale: Sharing one projection helper aligns archive creation and PR aggregation while retaining red failure evidence and fail-closed validation.

scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add a focused aggregate-PR regression and run archive plus PR validation suites.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Without an exact valid superseded transition, report validation uses the stored Outcome and fails on any mismatch.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add negative cases and retain existing stale-report and archive mutation coverage.
